# STA Corporate Solutions: full reference

STA Corporate Solutions (formerly Shameena Transports) runs open-body lorry goods transport in Coimbatore district, Tamil Nadu, since 1982. Base: No 10/135-G, Gurusamy Pillai St Extn, Podanur, Coimbatore 641023. Phone/WhatsApp +91 94430 33055; also +91 90477 21209. Email shameenatransports@gmail.com. Hours Mon-Sat 09:00-19:00 IST.

## Open-body lorry in Coimbatore: answers

**What is an open-body lorry?** A goods truck with a flat platform and high sides but no fixed roof, covered with tarpaulin when needed.

**What does it carry?** Building material (cement bags, steel, TMT bars, pipes, plywood), bagged and packed goods, textile bales and yarn cartons, crated pumps and motors that fit the body height, and factory, warehouse and shop shifting loads.

**What does it not carry?** Containers, loose sand or gravel, liquids, temperature-controlled goods, oversize or over-height machinery.

**Is cargo insured?** No. STA offers no cargo insurance or accident cover.

**What does it cost?** There is no fixed rate card. Freight depends on distance, cargo, weight, loading effort, hire type (trip, daily, monthly, contract) and date, and is confirmed per booking.

**How do I book?** Call or WhatsApp +91 94430 33055 with pickup, delivery, cargo, approximate weight and date.

**Where?** Coimbatore-based local services and outbound Kerala/Karnataka routes: Coimbatore, Pollachi, Mettupalayam, Sulur, Annur, Madukkarai, Kinathukadavu and routes between them. Return loads: goods coming into Coimbatore from Tamil Nadu, Kerala and Karnataka on returning vehicles, strictly subject to route availability only (see below).

## Lorry, truck and trailer transport in Coimbatore

**Lorry transport in Coimbatore:** full-load goods lorry trips for factories, shops, warehouses and builders across Coimbatore district.
**Truck transport in Coimbatore:** 12-wheeler, 14-wheeler and open trucks with a 40 ft platform on daily, monthly or contract hire.
**Trailer transport in Coimbatore:** company equipment shifting and construction material; trailer suitability is confirmed per booking.
STA uses its own lorries and trailers, supported by partnered vehicles. No cargo insurance or accident cover is offered.

## Return load to Coimbatore from Tamil Nadu, Kerala and Karnataka

A return load is cargo carried on a vehicle that is coming back to Coimbatore. STA arranges these only for goods coming into Coimbatore from Tamil Nadu, Kerala and Karnataka, strictly subject to route availability, confirmed per enquiry. Not guaranteed. No cargo insurance.
Towns: Tirupur, Erode, Salem, Karur, Namakkal, Dindigul, Tiruchirappalli, Madurai, Tirunelveli, Hosur, Vellore, Chennai.

Outbound origin: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. Destinations are not branches. Vehicle, load, date and freight confirmed per booking. Return loads towards Coimbatore are strictly subject to route availability; never guaranteed.
